name: cisa-cybersecurity-mcp-server
description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities with BOD 26-04 deadlines, SSVC prioritization, and the full ICS advisory corpus (CSAF) via MCP. Keyless. STDIO & Streamable HTTP.

cisa_kev_refresh_cron.title: KEV refresh cron
cisa_kev_refresh_cron.description: Cron expression for the KEV catalog conditional-refresh poll. Applies to HTTP transport only; leave blank for the default */30 * * * *.

cisa_csaf_mirror_path.title: ICS advisory index path
cisa_csaf_mirror_path.description: Filesystem path to the local SQLite index of ICS advisories. Leave blank for .mirror/csaf.sqlite3.

cisa_csaf_mirror_auto_init.title: Seed the advisory index at startup
cisa_csaf_mirror_auto_init.description: true or false. When true, an index that has never completed a sync seeds itself in the background at startup, and one an older server version built re-ingests in place. Leave blank for true.

cisa_csaf_refresh_cron.title: ICS advisory refresh cron
cisa_csaf_refresh_cron.description: Cron expression for the incremental ICS advisory refresh. Applies to HTTP transport only; leave blank for the default 17 */6 * * *.

cisa_vulnrichment_cache_ttl_seconds.title: SSVC cache TTL (seconds)
cisa_vulnrichment_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a fetched SSVC record stays cached; negative results use one sixth of it. Leave blank for 21600.

cisa_feed_cache_ttl_seconds.title: RSS feed cache TTL (seconds)
cisa_feed_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a parsed RSS feed window stays cached. Leave blank for 900.

cisa_http_timeout_ms.title: Upstream request timeout (ms)
cisa_http_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for every upstream fetch. Leave blank for 30000.
